Diwali is a wonderful festival. Given the time constraint, I would prioritize decorating the house first. Stopping the activity altogether might disappoint your nephew and potentially damage your relationship with him. A more constructive approach would be to gently guide your nephew and use the experience as a teaching moment, rather than letting it become a reason to stop the activity altogether.
